items.question: What happens when a file has no scenarios at all?
items.ticket: Valid files return scenarios in order
items.chose: Treats a Feature with no scenarios as valid and returns an empty scenarios array.
items.instead: Raise a ParseError because the file has no scenario.

items.question: How is an empty file, or one with no Feature: line, reported?
items.ticket: Invalid files report the line of the error
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at line 1 for a file with no Feature: line. If other content comes first, it throws at that content's line.
items.instead: Report the last line, or no line, or return an empty feature.

items.question: Are Scenario Outline / Scenario Template and Rule blocks supported?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError saying Scenario Outline or Rule is not supported, at that line.
items.instead: Parse outlines as scenarios, with Examples tables, or skip them.

items.question: Are Background steps returned, and where do they go?
items.chose: Collects Background steps into a separate background array and does not copy them into each scenario. The array is null when there is no Background.
items.instead: Prepend the background steps to every scenario, or ignore the Background.

items.question: Are tags, doc strings and tables captured, and how?
items.chose: Attaches tags to the next Scenario as strings that keep the '@'. Doc strings become arrays of lines. Tables become arrays of trimmed cell arrays.
items.instead: Ignore tags, doc strings and tables, or store tags without '@' and doc strings as a single string.

items.question: What happens to tags placed before the Feature: line?
items.chose: Discards them silently as feature-level tags.
items.instead: Keep them as feature tags, or raise an error.

items.question: What happens to tags followed by something other than a Scenario, such as a step, Background or end of file?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the line of the first tag line.
items.instead: Report the line of the offending following content, or ignore the tags.

items.question: What happens to free text between the Feature: line and the first block, and to unrecognised lines inside a block?
items.chose: Ignores free text in the feature description. Throws a ParseError for any line inside a Background or Scenario that is not a step. Also throws if a step appears before any block.
items.instead: Ignore prose in scenarios too, or reject description text.

items.question: Which step keywords are accepted, and what are the rules for spacing and case?
items.chose: Accepts only Given, When, Then, And, But and '*', case-sensitive, followed by one space and any text. A bare keyword with no text is an error.
items.instead: Allow case-insensitive or localized keywords, or allow a keyword with empty text.

items.question: How are CRLF line endings and a byte order mark handled?
items.chose: Strips the trailing \r from each line and a leading BOM from the first line.
items.instead: Treat the BOM as content and fail, or leave \r in the text.

items.question: How are doc strings delimited, indented and closed?
items.chose: Accepts """ or ``` as delimiters, strips the opening delimiter's indentation from each line, and keeps comments and blank lines inside. An unclosed doc string errors at the line that opened it. A second table or doc string on one step is rejected.
items.instead: Accept only """, keep the raw indentation, or report an unclosed doc string at the end of the file.

items.question: How are malformed table rows and escapes in cells handled?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError if a row has text after the last pipe. Unescapes \|, \\ and \n, and does not check that rows have the same number of cells.
items.instead: Accept an unterminated row, or require every row to have the same column count.
